technical.lead: FMRB EO T-1: Treasury OCCIP joins witness slate, FTC + GAO amicus
technical.body: The Frontier Model Review Board executive-order interagency-review push enters the final business day before the May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing. Senate Cyber Subcommittee staff release a Thursday-morning final hearing-readiness memo locking the witness slate at eight with the addition of the Department of Treasury Office of Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructure Protection Assistant Secretary, joining Wednesday's seven (NIST Director Locascio, ODNI cyber lead, NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director, Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center representative, Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Director, Federal Communications Commission Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau Chief, and Department of Energy Cyber Security, Energy Security, and Emergency Response Assistant Secretary). The Federal Trade Commission Office of Technology plus the Government Accountability Office Strategic Issues Team file a joint Thursday amicus letter joining the now-sixteen-organization coalition, narrowing focus to the per-state attorney-general consultation pathway plus the AISI cyber-evaluation reciprocity 120-day placement window alignment plus a new GAO independent-audit recommendation pathway. House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology issues a Thursday-morning press release confirming the parallel 30-day House technical review window now sits in joint-resolution drafting alongside the Senate Cyber Subcommittee staff. White House OSTP holds the Thursday-afternoon line that the draft remains in interagency review with no signing window before May 22; the May 15 classified witness session opens at 14:00 EDT with an unclassified press follow-on at 16:30 EDT.

technical.lead: Indo-Pacific reciprocity hits 13: UAE formal, Saudi adjacent track
technical.body: The Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter reaches a fresh thirteen-jurisdiction count on Thursday with the first formal Middle East exploratory observer plus the OECD GENAI working-group attestation-field schema note. The United Arab Emirates Cybersecurity Council and the Israel National Cyber Directorate jointly publish a Thursday-morning exploratory-observer commitment paired with a Saudi Arabia National Cybersecurity Authority Thursday-afternoon adjacent entry note signaling parallel exploratory-observer interest, citing the Wednesday Brazil ANCiber plus South Africa CSH-DCDT precedent as the cross-continental procedural baseline; the UAE entry is the first Middle East formal entry into the cohort and the Saudi adjacent track marks the first GCC adjacent extension. The cohort now spans thirteen named candidates (Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand formally; Canada, Australia, India, Taiwan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Brazil as observers; South Africa, UAE as exploratory observers; Saudi Arabia in adjacent-track pre-commitment) plus the originating UK and EU. The OECD GENAI working-group secretariat publishes a Thursday-afternoon procedural note formalizing the cyber-evaluation reciprocity attestation field schema as a draft Recommendation text with formal member-state circulation in the June 2-6 plenary window, citing the now-fourteen-jurisdiction cohort visibility as the operative procedural baseline.

technical.lead: LangChain CVE-2026-44967 extends agent-loader taxonomy to 10 CVEs
technical.body: A tenth agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE drops on Thursday-morning Pacific time, extending the Wednesday Trail of Bits nine-CVE taxonomy to a fresh three-tier-spanning instance. LangChain CVE-2026-44967 (CVSS 8.8) is a path-traversal vulnerability in the workflow-state checkpoint loader's intermediate hand-off serializer that lets an attacker overwrite arbitrary host paths during cross-step state migration, mirroring the AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 Wednesday workflow-state pattern but at a finer-grained intermediate-state hand-off surface; the LangChain maintainer team ships v0.3.7 same-day with the patch plus a paired backport advisory for the v0.2.x and v0.1.x branches the NHS England blocklist references. Trail of Bits publishes a Thursday extended addendum updating its Wednesday taxonomy from nine to ten agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader CVEs, reaffirming the three-tier signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation plus workflow-state path-canonicalization common-mitigation pattern now extended with an intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization sub-pattern. DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft co-publish a Thursday joint follow-up addendum v3 (arxiv 2605.06712v3) extending the Wednesday v2 paper with the intermediate-state serializer canonicalization formal-verification pattern; LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Pydantic AI publish Thursday parallel reaffirmation that the mid-June default-shipment commitment now covers all four tier-and-sub-tier surfaces.

technical.lead: Cerebras logs third consolidation day; SEC ships 3rd sample comment letter
technical.body: Cerebras CBRS Thursday session prints a third consecutive consolidation day with a fresh institutional-buyside ratchet. The opening print at $196.20 lifts the stock 0.2 percent from Wednesday's $195.80 close, with the intraday range tightening to $194.90-$198.40 and the close at $197.10 (up 0.7 percent), trailing-five-session turnover crossing $5.9B with the institutional-buyside cumulative net position estimated at 35 percent of float (up from 33 percent Wednesday). Bernstein issues a Thursday-morning update note lifting the post-IPO price-target floor from $172 to $185 (still Market-Perform) citing the now-three-consecutive-trading-day consolidation pattern plus the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close timeline visibility-narrowing language; Morgan Stanley reiterates the $192 target with the upside-tilt $235 scenario probability lifted to 38 percent (from 28 percent Wednesday); Wells Fargo Securities holds Buy at $208; Jefferies initiates Outperform at $225. The SEC Division of Corporation Finance posts a Thursday-morning EDGAR release pairing a third sample comment letter on AI-services-revenue measurement basis (addressing minimum-commit hyperscaler-anchor warrant true-up adjustments plus rev-share-pool earnout disclosure) with a Corp Fin Securities Act Forms staff-guidance refresh on the hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity counterparty disclosure shape, expanding the precedent set anchored by the May 8 and May 13 sample comment letters. Tenstorrent receives a Thursday-afternoon first-round Corp Fin comment-letter acknowledgement at the 10-business-day mark of its 30-60 day review window.

technical.lead: vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 closes parity; Unsloth ships intermediate-state mitigation
technical.body: vLLM v0.11.4 release-candidate plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 plus Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1 Thursday point releases ship the intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization extension and consolidate the signed-checkpoint loader default across all three open-source serving stacks. vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 ships a Thursday release-candidate adding the signature-verified model-checkpoint loader as the documented default for new installs (closing the parity gap with SGLang and TGI from Wednesday) plus shipping the intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization mitigation compatible with the Thursday LangChain CVE-2026-44967 disclosure. Yotta Labs' canonical benchmark refresh places the shared-prefix workload at approximately 18,420 tok/s on vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 (up 7 percent from 17,140 Wednesday) versus 19,210 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 (up 2 percent from 18,860 Wednesday) — the throughput gap narrows to 4.3 percent (vs 9.1 percent Wednesday), the tightest gap since the benchmark cycle began. Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a Thursday production-deployment note reporting that the v0.11.4-rc1 release-candidate plus the new mitigation close the L40S edge-tier latency gap to parity (1.00x Infire-versus-vLLM ratio, vs 1.12x Wednesday). Unsloth ships its Thursday changelog adding a seventh refinement track to the multi-GPU NCCL backend for the router-only LoRA recipe plus an extension of the workflow-state path-canonicalization primitive to cover the Thursday LangChain intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization sub-pattern, holding first-mover status as the local-LLM fine-tuning stack to ship the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation alongside the now-four-tier-and-sub-tier surface coverage ahead of the framework cohort's coordinated mid-June default-shipment target.
